access_boundary: This record represents the Claude Opus 5.5 release of September 22, 2026, the first model of the Claude 5.5 family with the pinned claude-opus-5-5 API identifier. The reviewed Opus 5 and Opus 4.8 lines, earlier Opus releases, and independent hosts are separate boundaries.
strengths: Dated first-party announcement and docs page with per-platform model identifiers and a retirement commitment of no sooner than September 2027
Served on the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Microsoft Foundry
tradeoffs: Closed weights served only through managed APIs
Always-on thinking cannot be disabled and forced tool-use errors break some Opus 5 migration paths
